We need answer a Chinese economics multiple choice. Need analyze thoroughly. Question: 在完全竞争厂商的短期均衡产量上，AR小于SAC但大于AVC，则厂商____ Options:
A. 亏损，立即停产
B. 亏损，但应继续生产
C. 亏损，生产或不生产都可以
D. 获得正常利润，继续生产

We need choose correct. Perfectly competitive firm short-run equilibrium output. AR = price = demand = MR. SAC = short-run average cost. AVC = short-run average variable cost. Given AR < SAC but AR > AVC. Since AR=SAC would break-even (normal profit). AR<SAC => price below average total cost => loss (including fixed cost). But if price > AVC, firm should continue producing in short run to cover some fixed cost; shutdown if P<AVC. If P=AVC indifferent. Here > AVC, so loss but continue production. Answer B. Need final line exactly "答案：B". Could include explanation? User asks select correct; final line should be format. We can provide concise explanation in Chinese then final line. Ensure final last line exactly. Need no extra after. final.
content:
在完全竞争厂商中，AR 等于市场价格。若 AR < SAC，说明价格低于短期平均成本，厂商亏损；但 AR > AVC，说明价格仍能覆盖平均可变成本，因此短期应继续生产，以减少亏损。

答案：B
